candidates.explanation: Pipeline-aware coordinated relaxation. When total pipeline is high relative to recent demand, trim orders modestly to avoid upstream backlog; when pipeline is low and backlog exists, add small orders to protect downstream service. Corrections are small and node-symmetric so HAPPO remains the base policy.

Backlog-sensitive smoothing with downstream protection. Increase orders only when backlog is large and pipeline is thin; reduce cautiously when pipeline already covers demand and no backlog pressure exists. Keeps cuts bounded so downstream nodes are not starved.

Growth-adaptive damping using delayed delivered-demand growth. When growth is high and pipeline is thin with backlog, add a small amount; when growth is low and pipeline is excessive, trim modestly. Avoids overreaction to noisy growth estimates.

rules.when: growth > 1.2 and pipeline < recent and backlog > 0
